about_bio: Learning across India, Scotland and the United States taught me that the same problem looks different depending on where you stand. So I collect perspectives, and turn them into short books.

They aren’t lectures. Each one is a ten-minute conversation: I share what I’ve noticed, ask you a question, and leave space on the page for your answer. And every book ends with a poem, because some ideas only land when they’re felt.
about_poem: The engineer in me builds the question.
The poet in me leaves it open.
